news.text: 3 October saw the official **German reunification** (*Tag der Deutschen Einheit*) take place at midnight, as the German Democratic Republic (East Germany) formally dissolved and integrated into the Federal Republic of Germany. Tens of thousands of jubilant citizens gathered before the **Brandenburg Gate** and the Reichstag in Berlin under displays of fireworks, bringing a formal end to **45 years of Cold War division**.
news.youtube: German reunification Brandenburg Gate October 3 1990 midnight celebration

news.text: 5 October saw Paramount Pictures' romantic fantasy thriller ***Ghost*** receive its nationwide theatrical release in the United Kingdom. Starring Patrick Swayze, **Demi Moore**, and Whoopi Goldberg, the poignant supernatural drama captivated audiences and critics alike, turning the film's famous pottery-wheel scene set to The Righteous Brothers' *Unchained Melody* into an **iconic pop-culture touchstone**.

news.text: 15 October saw Soviet President **Mikhail Gorbachev** awarded the **Nobel Peace Prize** by the Norwegian Nobel Committee in Oslo. The committee honoured the Soviet leader for his pioneering policies of *glasnost* and *perestroika*, his crucial role in arms reduction negotiations, and his refusal to use military force as communist regimes crumbled peacefully across **Eastern Europe**.
news.youtube: Gorbachev wins Nobel Peace Prize October 1990 news

news.text: 27 October saw the NWA hold ***Halloween Havoc 1990*** at the UIC Pavilion in Chicago. In a chaotic main event, NWA World Heavyweight Champion **Sting** defended his title against 6-foot-9 monster **Sid Vicious**. When a fake Sting (secretly Barry Windham) swapped places and took a count-out loss, the real Sting emerged to restart the match and pin Vicious with a **sunset flip**.
news.youtube: Sting vs Sid Vicious Halloween Havoc 1990 match

news.text: 28 October saw American singer Maria McKee spend her fourth consecutive week at number one on the UK Singles Chart with ***Show Me Heaven***. Taken from the soundtrack to Tom Cruise's NASCAR drama ***Days of Thunder***, the soaring orchestral power ballad remained at the summit for four weeks and stood as one of the best-selling **British singles of the autumn**.

gaming.title: The Secret of Monkey Island
gaming.reviewQuote: Without doubt the funniest, most imaginative, and best-constructed adventure game ever produced. Ron Gilbert and his team have created an outright masterpiece.
gaming.headline: Rubber Chickens, Insult Sword Fighting, and Guybrush Threepwood's Pirate Quest
gaming.gameplay: Released in October 1990 by Lucasfilm Games, *The Secret of Monkey Island* redefined graphic adventures. Conceived and directed by **Ron Gilbert** alongside co-writers Tim Schafer and Dave Grossman, players guided enthusiastic wannabe-pirate **Guybrush Threepwood** across Mêlée Island to pass the Three Trials and defeat the ghost pirate LeChuck. Gilbert revolutionised the genre through his SCUMM engine interface, eliminating cruel unwinnable states, dead-ends, and unfair player deaths, whilst replacing arbitrary puzzles with clever inventory logic and the legendary **insult sword fighting** minigame.
gaming.reception: Critics showered *The Secret of Monkey Island* with near-universal acclaim upon release. Reviewers praised its lush 256-colour VGA pirate backdrops, witty comedic dialogue, and Michael Land's atmospheric Caribbean reggae musical score, hailing it as an artistic triumph that surpassed rival Sierra On-Line adventure titles.
gaming.impact: Consistently ranked among the greatest video games of all time, *Monkey Island* birthed an iconic multi-game franchise, elevated video game comedy writing to an artform, and established Lucasfilm Games (soon LucasArts) as the undisputed gold standard of adventure gaming.
